headline: Held public hearings on bond resolutions for wastewater, sewer, landfill, pool, and DPW garage projects, with no votes recorded
summary: The Board held public hearings on eight bond resolutions, R-26-059, R-26-060, R-26-061, R-26-062, R-26-063, R-26-066, R-26-072, and R-26-073, covering wastewater plant upgrades, sewer infrastructure, landfill improvements, solid waste equipment, swimming pool repairs, and a new Division of Public Works garage and fleet maintenance facility. Residents including Laurie Ortolano and Bill Terault spoke in opposition to several items, while city officials and commissioners spoke in favor. The minutes record each hearing being opened and closed but do not record a vote on any of the resolutions themselves.
